sections.shortTitle: N -W F P Elementary Education Foundation Amendment Ordinance 2002
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ORDINANCE XLIII OF 2002
NORTH-WEST
FRONTIER PROVINCE ELEMENTARY EDUCATION FOUNDATION (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2002
ORDINANCE XLIII OF
2002
An Ordinance
further to amend the North-West Frontier Province Elementary Education
Foundation Ordinance, 2002
[Gazette of
N.-W.F.P., Extraordinary, 25th October, 2002]
No. LEGIS:1(5)02/7655, dated
25-10-2002.--The following Ordinance by the Governor of the North-West
Frontier Province is hereby published for- general information:--
1. Short title and
commencement.--(1) This Ordinance may be called the North-Vilest Frontier
Province Elementary Education Foundation (Amendment) Ordinance, 2002.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

Amendment of section 4 of N.W.F.P. Ordinance No. XXX of 2002

ORDINANCE XLIII OF 2002
NORTH-WEST
FRONTIER PROVINCE ELEMENTARY EDUCATION FOUNDATION (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2002
ORDINANCE XLIII OF
2002
An Ordinance
further to amend the North-West Frontier Province Elementary Education
Foundation Ordinance, 2002
[Gazette of
N.-W.F.P., Extraordinary, 25th October, 2002]
No. LEGIS:1(5)02/7655, dated
25-10-2002.--The following Ordinance by the Governor of the North-West
Frontier Province is hereby published for- general information:--
2. Amendment of section 4 of
N.W.F.P. Ordinance No. XXX of 2002.-In the North-West Frontier Province
Elementary Education Foundation Ordinance, 2002 (N.-W.F.P. Ordinance No. XXX of
2002), hereinafter referred to as the said Ordinance, in section 4, in
sub-section (2), for clause (b), the following shall be substituted, namely:
"(b) to
improve literacy, with particular focus on women; through opening of new
community and non-formal schools and employment of teachers; "
